description: On the green bed sheet in front of you are a spread of colorful beads, a partly made yellow-and-orange beaded strand, and a black tape dispenser nearby. The right hand reaches into the bead pile, pinches up individual beads, and brings them toward the strand while the left hand holds the string end and guides it; both hands come together to slide a bead onto the string, then the right hand lets go and returns to the pile for another bead while the left hand keeps the necklace steady.
